addKeyByHand: Or add this key by hand
heroTitle: Manage the TopupGame by Uxiolabs top-up platform.
heroSubtitle: Sign in to monitor transactions, oversee finances, and manage top-up operations across every game.
twoFactorCodeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code for this account.
signInSubtitle: Enter your credentials to access the admin dashboard.
twoFactorSubtitle:
A code from your authenticator app, on top of your password. Required for admin accounts — the panel can move
          money and read every customer’s contact details.
notSetUp: Two-factor is not set up on this account.
isActive: Two-factor is active on this account.
moveHint:
Changed phone, reinstalled your authenticator, or moving to a different app? Move it across — your
                current device keeps working until the new one is confirmed.
unfinishedMove:
A move was started but never confirmed. Starting again replaces it with a fresh code to scan — your
                current authenticator is unaffected either way.
currentAuthenticatorCode: A code from your current authenticator
currentCodeHint:
Proving you still hold the device being replaced is what stops someone who got into this session
                    from quietly moving it to their own.
turnOffHint:
Admin accounts are asked to set it up again at the next sign-in, so this is rarely what you want — to
                change device, move it instead.
moved: Authenticator moved. Your old device no longer works.
disabled: Two-factor disabled. Please sign in again.
enrolSubtitle:
Admin accounts need a code from an authenticator app on top of a password — the panel can move money and read
          every customer’s contact details. Set it up once and you are done.
needAnApp: You will need an authenticator app — Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or similar.
